href="/w/Equilibrium_League" title="Equilibrium League">Equilibrium League</a> allows players to earn <a href="/w/League_points" title="League points">league points</a> and unlock <a href="/w/Equilibrium_League/Relics" title="Equilibrium League/Relics">relics</a>. Tasks are separated into 5 tiers of difficulty (easy, medium, hard, elite, master), with each tier rewarding progressively more points.
